title: Titanic Chapter09 lifeboat evacuation: exact hand-authored 24-beat source-first edit
narration: Keep existing 12 Kokoro T09_P01–P12 voice recordings and every original A/B cut time unchanged

shots.onscreen_label: THE ACTUAL TITANIC BOAT DECK · 11 APR 1912
shots.editorial_why: The dated real boat deck establishes the high deck and davit setting discussed in the opening; it is explicitly not a photograph of evacuation.

shots.onscreen_label: PORT-SIDE BOAT DECK BEFORE THE SINKING
shots.editorial_why: An independently photographed side of the same vessel supplies physical human-scale evidence of the narrow open deck. No night of 14 April footage is claimed.
A real pre-sinking photograph identifies officers associated with differing port/starboard evacuation instructions; it does not purport to capture those instructions.
An authentic 1912 inquiry illustration points to eyewitness uncertainty, rather than asserting one single officer rule.

shots.onscreen_label: EARLY BOAT TIMES COME FROM LATER TESTIMONY
shots.editorial_why: Actual US Senate Titanic investigation photograph shows where recollections were tested, not a photograph of boat seven leaving.
Evidence-based British report launch sequence and prominent unreliable-witness-times caveat; exact clock photo cannot exist.
Two authentic rescue images show the type of open boat recovered; not evidence of loading sequence or davit capacity.

shots.onscreen_label: DAVITS: HOW THE LOWERING GEAR WORKED
shots.editorial_why: Historical engineering mechanism cannot be demonstrated by a still after recovery; a labelled reconstruction makes the physical issue clear.
Survivor-family photograph connects named human lives to the uncertainty of separating from relatives. No specific private emotions are attributed to the photographed individuals.
Actual Ogden lifeboat photograph after rescue conveys the physical exposure of the craft, not a specific family's departure.

shots.onscreen_label: MOVING FROM LOWER DECKS · DIAGRAM, NOT A PHOTO
shots.editorial_why: Actual routes and access differences require disclosed ship-layout explanation, not invented locked-gate footage.
Actual dated view provides spatial context for deck-to-deck travel, but deliberately makes no claim to show third-class access barriers.
No authentic photograph records the final roof-of-quarters movements; draw source-grounded locations as a transparent schematic.

shots.onscreen_label: COLLAPSIBLES A AND B WERE NOT NORMALLY LAUNCHED
shots.editorial_why: The British investigation distinguishes boats floating off from normal lowering; a sourced fact diagram is appropriate.
Returning to the same verified family photo now emphasizes the varied lived experiences behind statistics, with no invented specific actions.
Authentic 1912 photo shows those physical boats after rescue; no unsupported assertion about who held which station.

shots.onscreen_label: THE ACTUAL DECK BEFORE IT TILTED
shots.editorial_why: This real pre-disaster boat deck is a baseline for the following slope diagram; not presented as a sinking image.

shots.onscreen_label: DECK SLOPE INCREASED AS THE BOW DESCENDED
shots.editorial_why: Disclosed mechanical illustration of the changing physical environment; no 1912 live-camera image exists.

shots.onscreen_label: TITANIC BEFORE THE FINAL NIGHT · SOUTHAMPTON
shots.editorial_why: Original vessel portrait creates an evidenced before/after contrast; it does not depict rockets, flooding, or darkness.

shots.onscreen_label: DISTRESS ROCKETS AND WATER · EVIDENCE TIMELINE
shots.editorial_why: A verified approximate timeline explains distress rockets and worsening flooding; not fabricated rocket photography.
Real post-sinking lifeboat image anchors the equipment whose rated capacity is compared next; occupancy is never inferred from that photograph.
Source-grounded comparison of rated places and real departures; photographs alone cannot justify counts.
Reuses period survivor-family image deliberately at the moral conclusion and bridges to next chapter's class study.

shots.onscreen_label: RELATIVES SOUGHT NEWS AFTER THE SINKING
shots.editorial_why: Actual White Star office after the disaster illustrates the families and consequences; explicitly post-sinking, not class-route evidence.
